label: History of founded coming-to-be
definition: FoundedComingToBeAt h Concrete v holds when every contingent concrete individual of history v comes to be (AllContingentsComeToBeAt) and some contingent concrete individual is present at a moment t with a founded past: Acc of the strict order at t, so there is no endless descending sequence of moments below t. PossiblyFoundedComingToBe h Concrete w says some history accessible from w satisfies this. A history with a first moment occupied only by a necessary thing and a contingent thing appearing later satisfies it; an initial state whose contingent things never came to be does not; an endless past in which each contingent thing is preceded by another does not.
note: Analyst framework definition; attribution deferred. A founded past at one moment is not a metric claim that the past is finite. It gives a minimal moment at or below that moment, so it strictly strengthens its weak sibling, a begun past (8aca16f2; History of begun coming-to-be 0a1dd099; BegunComingToBe.possiblyBegunOfFounded). It is not implied by a first moment of the whole time order: in continuous time with a first moment no later moment has a founded past (t, t/2, t/4, … descend endlessly; checked for non-negative rationals in BegunComingToBe.controls). It is a possibility premise about one accessible history, not a claim about the actual world. Whether such a history is metaphysically possible remains OPEN, and is denied by the initial-state view and by views on which every possible past is endless.
